gaps.explanation: The JSON business-type receipts (67,155) come from Exhibit H (p8, accrual, columns Sewer Fund / Water Fund): Total operating revenues 66,972 + Interest income 183. Detail holds only the Schedule 7 (p15, budgetary cash basis) fund totals Sewer 121,105 (index 48) and Water 45,592 (index 49) = 166,697; Sewer 121,105 includes the 98,624 transfer from other funds. The p8 fund columns tie exactly to the statement lines, so the p8 column rows are added: Sewer Utility collections 22,065 + Interest income 165 = 22,230 (Deposits, hookup fees prints 0); Water Utility collections 44,882 + Deposits, hookup fees 25 + Interest income 18 = 44,925. Once added, Schedule 7 lines 48 and 49 count the same funds' receipts a second time (same money, cash basis: p9 Sewer receipts from customers 22,316 + interest 165 + transfers 98,624 = 121,105; Water 45,574 + 18 = 45,592), so they are removed; the transfer that was inside line 48 gets its own line (Sewer Fund Transfers In 98,624, see transfers_net entry), so no money is lost. Check: 166,697 - 166,697 + 67,155 = 67,155 = statement.

gaps.explanation: The JSON business-type disbursements (94,169) are Exhibit H (p8, accrual) Total operating expenses. Detail holds the Schedule 7 (p15, budgetary cash) fund totals Sewer 120,582 (index 50) and Water 52,421 (index 51). Water: line 51 is p9 Water payments to suppliers 20,207 + employees 25,618 + supplies & services 6,596 = 52,421 (no capital purchases), the same money as the p8 Water operating rows, so the p8 Water rows are added (25,242 + 1,075 + 17,067 + Other 560 + 3,952 + Depreciation 9,246 = 57,142) and line 51 is removed as a duplicate. Sewer: line 50 (120,582) = p9 Sewer payments to suppliers 894 + employees 25,618 + supplies & services 1,415 (27,927 operating) + Purchase of capital assets/improvements 92,655; the 92,655 capital purchase is printed nowhere else, so line 50 is KEPT. The p8 Sewer operating rows Personal services 25,242, Repairs, maintenance 1,180, Utilities 828 and Supplies 235 (27,485) are the same operating money as the 27,927 inside line 50, so they are NOT added (would double count). Only Sewer Depreciation 9,542 (p8; non-cash, not inside line 50) is added. Result: schedule = Sewer 120,582 + 9,542 + Water 57,142 = 187,266 vs statement 94,169; schedule is higher by 93,097 = Sewer cash capital purchase 92,655 (p9, capital and related financing, not an operating expense on p8) + 442 (Sewer cash operating payments 27,927 vs accrual operating expenses excl. depreciation 27,485; p9 reconciliation Accounts payable (442)). This is a printed basis difference (cash budget schedule vs accrual statement) and cannot be closed without a derived figure.
